_rules.READ_THIS_FIRST: This file is the ONLY approved source of published copy for the Columbia Care website. If a string is not in this file with provenance 'ARTWORK', or has been moved to 'ARTWORK' after written client confirmation, it MUST NOT appear on the public site.

provenance.ARTWORK: Transcribed verbatim from one of the three client-supplied artwork files listed in `sources`. Safe to publish as-is.
provenance.ASK_CLIENT: Not stated anywhere in the artwork. `value` is null. The UI must render nothing for this field until the client confirms it in writing and the value is moved here with provenance changed to ARTWORK_CONFIRMED.
provenance.ARTWORK_CONFIRMED: Supplied by the client in writing after kickoff, not present in the original artwork. Record the date and channel in `confirmedOn`. Safe to publish.
provenance.RECOMMEND: A proposal from the build plan. Never a claim about this business. Needs sign-off before it becomes copy.

hardRules: Never invent a capacity, bed count, room type, rate, payment method, service, service area, licence number, staff name, or language.
A null value renders NOTHING. Not a placeholder, not 'Coming soon', not a stub heading.
The seven entries in `services` and the three in `careTypes` are the complete published offering. Nothing may be added without ARTWORK_CONFIRMED provenance.
Only Everett is a confirmed service area. Do not name another city.
No photograph of a person publishes without `releaseOnFile: true`.

tagline.value: A Place to Feel at Home, A Place to Be Cared For.

promise.value: A safe place. A caring heart. A better quality of life.

closingLine.value: We treat your loved one like family.
closingLine.note: Set in the script face. Use at most twice site-wide.

tourCta.value: Contact us to book a house tour!
tourCta.note: Keep this exact phrasing. 'House tour' is the client's own word and is warmer than 'schedule a visit'.

about.value: At Columbia Care Adult Family Home, we provide a safe, comfortable, and caring home where every resident is treated with dignity and respect. Our goal is to help each resident maintain the highest possible quality of life while receiving personalized care in a family-like environment.

meals.value: Our home provides a wide variety of nutritious, home-cooked meals daily for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks between meals such as fresh fruit and vegetables.

phonePrimary.question: Which number do we publish as the main line?

candidates.note: The only complete, usable number in the artwork.
Deliberately masked in the artwork. NOT a usable number. Shares the 425-212 prefix with the fax, suggesting a second line exists on that exchange.

sms.question: Is the primary line able to receive text messages? Many adult children text before they call.

geo.question: Geocode from the confirmed address once verified. Do not estimate coordinates.

serviceArea.note: Everett is the ONLY city named anywhere in the artwork. Do not add Mukilteo, Lynnwood, Marysville, Snohomish County or any other area without ARTWORK_CONFIRMED provenance.

locationLine.value: Close to Broadway Ave, easy access to Evergreen Way and Interstate 5.

hours.note: Justified by the 'Overnight — 24-Hour Care' schedule entry and the '24-Hour Care & Supervision' line. Maps to opens 00:00 / closes 23:59 in schema.

licenseNumber.question: What is the DSHS licence number? Families verify it on the DSHS lookup.

licensedCapacity.question: How many residents is the home licensed for?
licensedCapacity.note: NOT STATED ANYWHERE IN THE ARTWORK. Do not infer a number from what is typical for the category.

careTypes.note: The brochure chips. These three plus the seven services below are the complete published offering.

services.note: COMPLETE LIST. Respite, hospice-supportive, diabetic, mobility/transfer and incontinence care are common in this category but appear NOWHERE in the artwork. Do not add them.

value: Conveniently located near Broadway Avenue, Evergreen Way, and Interstate 5

everyDay.note: The 'Every Day at Columbia Care AFH' block. Becomes the What's Included grid.

schedule.note: All 13 entries transcribed verbatim. `accent` values come from the client's own icon badge colours in the infographic.

value.title: Good Morning
value.body: Residents are gently welcomed and assisted with getting up according to their individual care plans. Staff assist with toileting, bathing, dressing, grooming, and other activities of daily living.

value.title: Breakfast
value.body: Residents enjoy a nutritious homemade breakfast. Medications are administered according to each resident's orders and medication schedule. Staff document care and medication administration.

value.title: Morning Routine
value.body: Residents have time to relax, read, watch TV, listen to music, or socialize. Staff help residents with appointments and other scheduled activities.

value.title: Activities
value.body: Residents participate in activities based on their interests and abilities, such as:

value.title: Lunch
value.body: Residents enjoy lunch together. Staff encourage hydration and provide assistance as needed.

value.title: Rest & Personal Time
value.body: Residents can take a nap, relax in their rooms, watch television, or spend time with family and friends.

value.title: Afternoon Activities
value.body: Depending on the day, residents may enjoy a walk, outdoor time, an activity, an appointment, or simply socializing with others.

value.title: Dinner Preparation
value.body: Staff prepare a fresh, homemade dinner while maintaining a safe environment. Residents may spend time together in the common area.

value.title: Dinner
value.body: Residents enjoy dinner together. Staff provide assistance according to individual needs and document required care.

value.title: Evening Activities
value.body: Residents may watch a favorite program, listen to music, play games, talk with others, or visit with family.

value.title: Evening Routine
value.body: Staff assist residents with toileting, changing clothes, oral care, and getting ready for bed according to their care plans.

value.title: Quiet Time
value.body: The home becomes quieter so residents can rest. Staff continue safety checks and provide assistance as needed.

value.title: 24-Hour Care
value.body: Caregivers remain available throughout the night. Residents receive assistance when needed, and staff monitor safety and document any significant changes or care provided.
